claim: Read-only lock acquisition remains non-mutating when the lock disappears between existence check and open.

behavior.missing_lock: proceed without creating a lock file
behavior.lock_replaced_before_open: proceed without creating a lock file
behavior.existing_lock: acquire advisory lock and release it deterministically

risk_boundary: This helper is advisory only; callers needing a stable multi-file snapshot must retry or use an explicit writer-coordinated protocol.
next_action: Add a focused regression test for the disappearing-lock race and inspect all remaining read-only entrypoints for project_lock() creation side effects.
